purpose: Interactive Fiction Weaver draft for a low-resource Cetacean Navigator berth hearing at Brineglass Waystation. Tonal mode: humane workplace comedy with procedural stakes and a quiet undertow of exclusion.

local_awareness_summary.text: Sere-in-Return is an uplifted bottlenose dolphin and the wet-side hearing clerk. He can use the pool paddle and speaker, read light and low acoustic signals, feel pressure-pulse route traces across his body, and authorize this hearing's pause or local disposition.
The critical high acoustic detail is unreliable through Sere's old scar-noise, so the pressure-pulse channel is a practical access need rather than a decorative species cue.

Sere can observe Halden's schedule pressure, Mina's work, Toma's rail use, the board diagnostics, and custody marks. He cannot know whether Halden's selected account is honest beyond what the evidence supports.

frame_controls.text: Playable perspective remains local to Sere's wet-side position, body, interfaces, authority, and uncertainty. Dryside records reach him through the shared board, sealed drawer, speaker, sightlines, or another participant's observable action.
The scene establishes an ordinary channel test and docket routine before the equipment failure interrupts the hearing.

authority_boundaries.text: Sere owns the local hearing pause and berth-claim disposition, not the carrier's final bond review, corridor-wide certification, or another court's later judgment.

The failed pressure channel cannot be repaired by confidence language. Sere may pause, request translation, mark an embodied inference, or admit claimant testimony, each with a visible cost and evidence boundary.

object_custody.text: The sealed witness slate remains inside the evidence drawer and is represented by three visible custody marks. Halden's duplicate slate is claimant-held and never silently replaces the sealed trace.

required_semantics.text: Every preparation choice changes confidence, access, time, custody, learning, or claimant trust, and those changes are read after folding.
The final outcomes must distinguish a grounded decision from one that merely exports the channel failure into cargo, bond, schedule, or staff costs.

forbidden_resolutions.text: Do not give Sere omniscient access to Halden's intent, dryside evidence, or corridor-wide authority.
Do not turn the access failure into a consequence-free moral lesson; docking time, bond review, cargo delay, requester visibility, and staff labor remain material.

branch_and_fold_plan.summary: Four preparation choices fold into one trace replay; four channel-failure responses fold into one disposition threshold; three final dispositions select six state-gated endings.

branches.actor_intent: Establish an independent cross-channel baseline before claimant testimony shapes the hearing.
state_basis: Brineglass's board exposes one record through light, sound, pressure pulse, and raised notation.
A full test consumes scarce berth time.
reviewed_consequences: Raises record_confidence and witness_access while spending one berth minute; later replay and endings read both values.

branches.actor_intent: Preserve schedule margin by hearing the claimant's compact account first.
state_basis: Halden can summarize his own claim but does not own independent verification.
Lightsail reputation depends on reliable arrival and corridor trust.
reviewed_consequences: Raises carrier_trust and berth_minutes while lowering independent record_confidence; later prose identifies when claimant framing replaced baseline.

branches.actor_intent: Make cross-body route reading part of ordinary apprenticeship before it becomes an emergency accommodation.
state_basis: Navigator apprentices learn route notation and cross-body etiquette.
The dry gallery has a tactile rail synchronized with the pool trace.
reviewed_consequences: Raises apprentice_understanding and witness_access while spending one berth minute; Toma's later posture and knowledge change.

branches.actor_intent: Verify the sealed trace and custody marks before accepting testimony about it.
state_basis: Witness slates pass through a sealed evidence drawer beneath the route board.
Shared records are a source of Navigator corridor authority.
reviewed_consequences: Raises evidence_custody and record_confidence; those values gate the strong rejection ending.

branches.actor_intent: Stop the hearing clock until access is restored, accepting visible ownership of the delay.
state_basis: The hearing clerk may pause the berth clock for manual translation.
Brineglass records which party requested the interruption.
reviewed_consequences: Sets clock_paused and requester_recorded and partly restores witness_access; the pause enables a grounded adjournment and remains visible in later prose.

branches.actor_intent: Rebuild shared evidence through Mina's manual light, rail, speech, and pool translation.
state_basis: Poor stations may use staffed mediation when redundant controls fail.
reviewed_consequences: Sets manual_translation, restores record_confidence and witness_access, and spends two berth minutes; translated evidence persists into the ruling.

branches.actor_intent: Use embodied route expertise to estimate the missing pressure interval without claiming that inference is replay.
state_basis: Sere can feel surviving pressure waves across jaw, flank, fin, and scar tissue.
Navigator authority depends on trained route cognition but remains answerable to records and challenge.
reviewed_consequences: Sets embodied_inference, partly restores record_confidence, and spends one minute; the board and ending preserve the inference label.

branches.actor_intent: Use claimant testimony to preserve time while keeping its provenance visible.
state_basis: Halden holds a duplicate trace and can narrate selected timestamps.
Toma can compare the stated times to the working dry rail.
reviewed_consequences: Sets carrier_account_used and raises carrier_trust and record_confidence; later prose retains a claimant bracket instead of treating the account as independent evidence.

branches.actor_intent: Protect the carrier bond, berth access, and cargo schedule by admitting the hazard diversion.
state_basis: A strong admission requires both usable record confidence and Sere's access to the decisive evidence.
reviewed_consequences: Routes to admitted_with_shared_record when record_confidence and witness_access clear threshold; otherwise routes to admitted_under_access_debt.

branches.actor_intent: Refuse to certify the local claim from inaccessible or contested evidence.
state_basis: A strong rejection requires intact custody and at least partial independent confidence.
reviewed_consequences: Routes to rejected_with_intact_custody when evidence_custody and record_confidence clear threshold; otherwise rejection exports uncertainty without improving evidence.

branches.actor_intent: Keep the claim open until the translated interval survives one complete shared replay before final disposition.
state_basis: A pause or surviving berth margin can protect manual translation from being overtaken by allocation authority.
reviewed_consequences: Sets manual_translation and routes to a protected or already-overtaken adjournment based on clock_paused and berth_minutes.

audit.reviewer: Codex Aetheria world worker using the four required Ghostlight reviewer prompts as separate passes

review_passes.detected_tonal_mode: Humane workplace comedy with procedural stakes and a quiet undertow of exclusion.
acceptance_notes: A first pass found inconsistent literal clock values, a redundant adjournment label after the manual-translation branch, and an unread carrier_trust variable.
The repaired artifact uses one four-minute hearing margin inside a nine-minute turnover, makes the final hold require a complete shared replay, and reads carrier_trust at the disposition fold.
All four participants and the local authority boundary are introduced before the first choice; no folded scene assumes optional onboarding.

sources_checked.reason_checked: Primary institution, room, access, berth, court, and record authority.
Carrier reliability, reputation, and cargo pressure.
Shared hazard ledgers, rescue obligations, and recognized arbitration.
Nonhuman lineage, interface, habitat, labor, and recognition boundaries.
Outer-system waystations, route authority, docks, records, and supply intervals.
Usable evidence, access, care, maintenance, and institutional cost pressure.
Same-era example of a bottlenose Navigator serving court and ledger functions.

vault_backfill_candidates.artifact_origin: Brineglass opening, channel failure, and disposition paths.
vault_backfill_candidates.why_it_belongs: It supplies durable room-scale infrastructure, access politics, visual geometry, and a repeatable arbitration routine.
vault_backfill_candidates.how_to_add_without_bloat: Already added as one fixture-marked paragraph and committed in lore commit ba5c2ce.

acceptance_notes: The fixture keeps Brineglass's exact orbit and later history open, marks all cast and events as fixture-local drafts, and does not import the referenced pirate story character.
Sere's authority is explicitly a narrow Waystation Council delegation for this local docket; bond and corridor-wide standing remain later authorities.
The room-scale lore elaboration preceded prose and is already banked as ba5c2ce.

major_findings.why_it_matters: Text prompts alone cannot reliably preserve the pressure wall, board, drawer, routes, occlusion, and wet/dry body positions across sixteen frames.

acceptance_notes: A first pass removed a memory-dependent name typo, an affirmative-prompt violation, unsupported exact room dimensions, and an undescribed cargo-handler group.
All sixteen Ink visual ids map one-to-one to standalone base prompts and the BFL manifest contains sixteen matching concept prompts.
Verdict accepts the current visual plan and prompt manifest as concept-ready collateral only. It is explicitly not high-consistency replay-ready until the declared blockout is built.

review_passes.inferred_layout_summary: One long rectangular transfer room is split lengthwise into equal wet and dry halves by a waist-high pressure wall. Sere moves in a shallow-to-deep pool loop and reaches wet paddles; Mina moves between the far clerk console, the dry face of the evidence drawer, and the staff side of the tactile rail; Halden and Toma enter from the opposite dry door and stay on the claimant side. The route board bridges both halves at midpoint, the sealed drawer passes through the wall below it, and the berth window remains visible from wide gallery cameras.

diagram_or_visual_plan_needs.reason: Generated multi-angle art needs a geometry source stronger than text to preserve wet/dry division, sightlines, and body reach.
diagram_or_visual_plan_needs.minimum_required_detail: Use the declared fixed zones, three routes, two occluders, six camera slots, four staging slots, and three branch-state anchors.

acceptance_notes: The prose and plan preserve one coordinate frame, explicit role routes, compatible body reach, and a stable location for every consequential object.
Folded scenes retain the failed emitter, clock, custody, inference, claimant-account, and access states through conditions or modifiers.
The textual layout is sufficient to stage and review the IF; the declared blockout remains required for generated replay continuity.

review_notes: One-shot authoring is bootstrap scaffolding for the fixture corpus and does not claim to be a runtime responder capture.
The four reviewer prompts were applied as separate narrative, lore, visual, and spatial passes after artifact drafting.
No Ink compiler was present on PATH, so syntax received static structure checks but no compiled Ink JSON was produced.
